blurb: Airlink Tours offers guided bus and private tours from Toronto to Niagara Falls, including transportation, skip-the-line access to attractions, and optional meals. Tours include visits to Niagara City Cruises boat tour, Journey Behind the Falls, Skylon Tower, and other local sights. Private tours offer customizable itineraries and door-to-door service.
